Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

3 Designation 

3.1 A long series twist drill with 7*20 mm diameter, of ' tool type * A^ and for right-hand cutting 
conforming to this standard and made from high speed steel ( HS ) shall be designated at: 

Twist Drill 7*20 IS : 5102 HS 

3*2 Wlien the twist drilMs required with other tool types ( /y or 5) or with a driving tenon (T) 
this shall be mentioned in the designation as: 

Twist dnil 7*20 S — T IS . 5102 HS 

4. Tolerances — The flute length /l and overall length / may vary between the corresponding 
lengths specified for the preceding and the following ranges of diameters. 

Example: 

The flute length for 12 50 mm diameter may vary between the values 128 and 
140 mm from the specified value of 134 mm. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 'Tool type , unle&s otherwise specified' A( according to IS : 5099-1969 'Technical supply 
conditions for twist drills '. 

5.2 The detailed dimensions of the pomt and cutting angles shall be at the discretion of the 
manufacturer ( see also IS . 5099-1969 for recommendations regarding ' tool types ' ) 

5.3 The diameter d shall be measured as near the point as practicable. 

5.4 The flute length, overall length and tolerances for intermediate diameters shall be selected 
from the relevant range of diameters. 

5.5 Other requirements according to IS * 5099-1969. 

5.6 The dimensions for driving tenon shall be according to IS : 5360-1969 ' Dimensions for driving 
tenons '. 

5.7 The tolerance on parallel shank diameter shall be h9. 

6. Tests — According to IS : 5099-1969. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was based on ISO/R 494-1966 which has been reviewed by ISO and found 
technically suitable for transformation into ISO 494-1975 Recently this Indian Standard has also 
been reviewed and found to be technically identical with ISO 494-1975 ' Parallel Shanl( twist drills — 
Long series * issued by the International Organization for Standardization.
